title: Google urges EU top court to back ruling scrapping $1.7 billion antitrust fine
title_zh: 谷歌敦促欧盟最高法院支持取消 17 亿美元反垄断罚款的裁决
summary: Alphabet unit Google on Wednesday urged Europe's top court to dismiss EU antitrust regulators' appeal ‌against a lower court ruling that scrapped a €1.49 billion ($1.7 billion) fine, saying ‌the regulators' arguments were flawed.
summary_zh: Alphabet 旗下谷歌周三敦促欧洲最高法院驳回欧盟反垄断监管机构对下级法院撤销 14.9 亿欧元（17 亿美元）罚款的裁决提出的上诉，称监管机构的论点存在缺陷。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures extend gains ahead of earnings, wholesale inflation data
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在财报、批发通胀数据之前扩大涨幅
summary: The focus turns to Wednesday's release of the Producer Price Index after the latest Consumer Price Index data showed the largest single-month decline in inflation since April 2020.
summary_zh: 在最新的消费者价格指数数据显示通胀出现 2020 年 4 月以来最大单月降幅后，焦点转向周三发布的生产者价格指数。

title: Apple Intelligence AI service registered with China's cyberspace regulator
title_zh: Apple Intelligence人工智能服务已在中国网信监管机构注册
summary: China's cyberspace ‌regulator said on Wednesday ‌that Apple's on-device generative AI service "Apple Intelligence" ​has been registered for use on iPhones in the country.
summary_zh: 中国网络空间监管机构周三表示，苹果的设备端生成人工智能服务“Apple Intelligence”已在中国注册，可在 iPhone 上使用。

title: BMW races to catch up in a Chinese EV market that won't slow down
title_zh: 宝马竞相追赶中国电动汽车市场，势头不会放缓
summary: STORY: "The Neue Klasse was first unveiled by BMW five years ago, and that's the sort of typical speed it would take for cars to hit the market. So, four, five years would normally not be a problem.

title: ASML Raises Full-Year Outlook as AI Boosts Demand at Chipmakers
title_zh: 人工智能提振芯片制造商需求，ASML 上调全年业绩预期
summary: (Bloomberg) -- ASML Holding NV lifted its annual sales forecast for the second time this year as a surge in artificial intelligence spending drives demand for the Dutch company’s chip-making machines.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——ASML Holding NV 今年第二次上调了年度销售预期，因为人工智能支出的激增推动了对这家荷兰公司芯片制造机器的需求。

title: New York enacts statewide moratorium on AI data center construction: A closer look
title_zh: 纽约颁布全州暂停人工智能数据中心建设：仔细观察
summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed an executive order to place a moratorium on the construction of new AI data centers. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains the details.
summary_zh: 纽约州州长 Kathy Hochul 签署了一项行政命令，暂停建设新的人工智能数据中心。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 解释了细节。

title: Chinese AI model developer DeepSeek preps for IPO: What to know
title_zh: 中国人工智能模型开发商 DeepSeek 为 IPO 做准备：需要了解什么
summary: Chinese large language model (LLM) developer DeepSeek is reportedly preparing for an IPO later this year or in 2027. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley outlines what we know so far.
summary_zh: 据报道，中国大语言模型 (LLM) 开发商 DeepSeek 正准备在今年晚些时候或 2027 年进行 IPO。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 概述了我们目前所知的情况。

title: Why Meta stock suddenly broke out after a long slide
title_zh: 为什么Meta股票在长期下滑后突然爆发
summary: Meta stock is back in rally mode, for now.
summary_zh: 目前，Meta 股票又回到反弹模式。
